removal_probe_replay_python:
from __future__ import annotations

import sys
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from polisyos.foundry.methods.catalog.causal import tmle_core

source = Path(tmle_core.__file__).read_text()
mutation = sys.argv[1]
if mutation == 'source_identity':
    mutated = source
    for name in ('X', 'T', 'Y'):
        old = f'_hash_array(np.asarray({name}, dtype=float)),'
        assert old in mutated
        mutated = mutated.replace(old, f'"{name}-marker",')
    selector = 'test_full_data_identity_is_required_even_with_an_explicit_namespace[X-same-declared-source]'
elif mutation == 'current_diagnostic_policy':
    old = 'record["split_policy"] = contract.overlap_diagnostic_policy'
    assert old in source
    mutated = source.replace(old, 'record["split_policy"] = record.get("split_policy")')
    selector = 'test_current_diagnostics_reuse_immutable_fit_and_isolate_every_reader'
elif mutation == 'immutable_bytes':
    old = 'return np.frombuffer(array.tobytes(), dtype=array.dtype).reshape(array.shape)'
    assert old in source
    mutated = source.replace(old, 'return np.array(array, copy=True)')
    selector = 'test_current_diagnostics_reuse_immutable_fit_and_isolate_every_reader'
else:
    raise AssertionError(mutation)

assert mutated != source
# Compile an isolated in-memory mutant into the imported canonical module;
# no checkout/source/history is edited. All native fitting code is retained.
exec(compile(mutated, str(Path(tmle_core.__file__).with_suffix('.mutant.py')), 'exec'), tmle_core.__dict__)
print('target=b57708fcc95a778d7ff88c4001e4ac8ca74b7889 mutation=' + mutation)
code = pytest.main(['-o', 'addopts=', '-q', '-ra', 'tests/unit/foundry/methods/catalog/causal/test_tmle_fit_contract.py::' + selector])
print('expected_behavioral_rejection=1 observed_pytest_exit=' + str(code))
sys.exit(0 if code == 1 else 1)
